verdict.rationale: Retell documents two ways to test agents before real phone calls. Conductor can run simulation tests that play out a scenario against an agent "without making real phone calls". The dashboard "Test" button starts a free web call that needs no phone number. AI QA scoring exists, but it evaluates sampled calls you have already made, so it is not pre-deployment evals. Missing for 10: documented batch or regression simulation suites, a programmatic API/SDK for running simulated tests or evals before deploy, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the simulation feature.
